name: aiwalls-simple
description: IXT-SUITES full-UI rung for aiWalls (the FloorPlanEditor 'AI walls' vision-model trace button) — the leg ai-surfaces-simple.json deliberately deferred (it only store-flag-checked aiWalls because the button renders only once a 2D plan-trace backdrop image is uploaded). aiWalls AND its host planTraceBackdrop are BOTH pro-tier (default true), so in Simple mode neither the trace UI nor the button exists. Mirrors backdrop-upload-simple.json's real-file-input upload pattern, but for the 2D plan-trace backdrop (usePlanBackdrop.loadBackdrop) instead of the walk-mode window backdrop. Coverage: (A) Simple baseline — the Plan menu shows NO 'Reference photo…' / 'Set scale' / 'AI walls' at all (planTraceBackdrop pro-tier, forced off). (B) Pro — the trace UI appears; with no backdrop yet the 'AI walls' button is STILL absent (it needs a backdrop), then a tiny canvas-generated PNG is injected through the REAL hidden file input (native-setter + DataTransfer + change event → loadBackdrop), and once the backdrop loads the 'AI walls' button MOUNTS (real DOM-mount assertion, enabled). (C) Back to Simple with the backdrop still resident in component state — the button is ABSENT even though the backdrop is present (proving the tier gate hides it, not the missing backdrop), then (D) back to Pro WITHOUT re-uploading proves the backdrop was retained the whole time and the button reappears. (E) The pre-inference path is exercised safely: clicking 'AI walls' with no vision key opens the real 'Vision-model API key' PromptModal (usePlanAiWalls.runAiWalls's promptText), which is cancelled — runAiWalls returns at `if (!key) return` BEFORE classifyVisionEndpoint / recognizeFloorPlan's fetch, so no request to api.openai.com ever fires (a fetch spy records every call and the final assertion proves none hit openai/replicate; no 'AI drafted' notification, no second endpoint-confirm prompt). The real AI inference itself stays out of scope (needs a live key + network) exactly as for the other two AI surfaces — see TASKS.md IXT-SUITES. NOTE: the 'Plan ▾' menu trigger renders 'Plan' and ' ▾' as TWO text nodes, so clickByText can't match the whole label AND a stray editor re-render can toggle the local popover state — so the open/close steps are self-retrying evals (click until .plan-menu-panel is present / gone) rather than a single text/mouse click.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays-and-arm-fetch-spy
steps.comment: Clear onboarding + any persisted vision key (so runAiWalls takes the key-PROMPT path, never a silent keyed request), and install a non-blocking fetch spy that records every URL — the final assertion proves none reached a model provider.
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); localStorage.removeItem('hdb_ai_vision_key'); localStorage.removeItem('hdb_ai_vision_url'); } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); if (!window.__aiFetchLog) { window.__aiFetchLog = []; const orig = window.fetch; window.fetch = function(...args){ try { window.__aiFetchLog.push(String(args[0] && args[0].url ? args[0].url : args[0])); } catch {}; return orig.apply(this, args); }; } })()

steps.comment: The 'AI walls' button lives INSIDE the `backdrop ?` branch — with no backdrop loaded yet it must not render even in Pro. This is exactly why ai-surfaces could only store-flag-check aiWalls: the button is backdrop-gated.
steps.eval: (function(){ const panel = document.querySelector('.plan-menu-panel'); if (!panel) throw new Error('Plan menu panel missing in Pro'); if (!(panel.textContent||'').includes('Reference photo')) throw new Error("expected the 'Reference photo…' upload button (no backdrop yet)"); if ((panel.textContent||'').includes('AI walls')) throw new Error("'AI walls' button rendered before any backdrop was loaded — it must require a trace backdrop"); })()

steps.name: upload-trace-backdrop
steps.comment: Inject a tiny canvas-generated PNG through the REAL hidden trace file input (usePlanBackdrop's fileRef) via native-setter + DataTransfer + change event — the exact real path loadBackdrop() runs. No binary fixture on disk.
steps.eval: (async () => { const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 256; c.height = 192; const g = c.getContext('2d'); g.fillStyle = '#222'; g.fillRect(0,0,c.width,c.height); g.strokeStyle = '#8ab4ff'; g.lineWidth = 6; g.strokeRect(20,20,c.width-40,c.height-40); g.fillStyle = '#8ab4ff'; g.font = 'bold 22px sans-serif'; g.fillText('PLAN TRACE', 40, 110); const blob = await new Promise((r) => c.toBlob(r, 'image/png')); const file = new File([blob], 'trace-plan.png', { type: 'image/png' }); const input = document.querySelector('.plan-menu-panel input[type="file"]'); if (!input) throw new Error('trace file input not found in Plan menu (planTraceBackdrop off?)'); const dt = new DataTransfer(); dt.items.add(file); Object.defineProperty(input, 'files', { value: dt.files, configurable: true }); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); })()

steps.name: assert-key-prompt-and-no-network-yet
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__store.getState(); if (s.textPrompt === null) throw new Error('key PromptModal not open'); if (!document.body.textContent.includes('AI floor-plan recognition')) throw new Error('key prompt title missing'); const cancel = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.textContent.trim() === 'Cancel'); const cont = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.textContent.trim() === 'Continue'); if (!cancel || !cont) throw new Error('key prompt Cancel/Continue buttons missing'); const bad = (window.__aiFetchLog || []).filter((u) => /openai|replicate/i.test(u)); if (bad.length) throw new Error('a request to a model provider fired before inference was even requested: ' + bad.join(', ')); })()

steps.name: assert-no-network-no-walls-after-cancel
steps.comment: runAiWalls returns at `if (!key) return` on the cancelled key prompt — BEFORE classifyVisionEndpoint (no endpoint-confirm prompt) and BEFORE recognizeFloorPlan's fetch. So: no second prompt, no 'AI drafted' success / 'recognition failed' error notification, and the fetch spy recorded no openai/replicate call.
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__store.getState(); if (s.textPrompt !== null) throw new Error('a second prompt opened after cancelling the key — runAiWalls should have returned on empty key, never reaching the endpoint-confirm prompt'); const badNotif = (s.notifications || []).some((n) => /drafted|AI floor-plan recognition failed|AI recognition cancelled|Insecure AI endpoint/i.test((n.title || '') + ' ' + (n.message || ''))); if (badNotif) throw new Error('an AI-walls result/endpoint notification appeared even though the key prompt was cancelled before any request'); const bad = (window.__aiFetchLog || []).filter((u) => /openai|replicate/i.test(u)); if (bad.length) throw new Error('a model-provider fetch fired despite cancelling before inference: ' + bad.join(', ')); })()
